questions.question: Define infrared (IR) sensors and explain their basic operating principle in / obstacle detection.
questions.solution_html:
• Infrared(IR) sensors are devices that useinfrared light todetect objects ormeasure distance.
  • They work by emitting IR light from an LED and measuring the amount of reflected light
  • received by a photodiode or phototransistor. When an object is nearby, more IR light is
  • reflected back, allowing the sensor to detect its presence. This makes IR sensors commonly
  • usedfor simpleandfast obstacle detection.

questions.question: Write a program that uses a WHILE loopto blink an LED 5 times, with a 500ms / delay between each blink?
questions.solution_html:
• int led=13;
  • int count =0;
  • voidsetup() {
  • pinMode(led, OUTPUT);
  • }
  • voidloop(){
  • count = 0;
  • while<5){
  • digitalWrite(led, HIGH);
  • delay(500);
  • digitalWrite(led, LOW);
  • delay(500);
  • count++;
  • }
  • while(1);
  • }

questions.question: Write a program to rotate a servo from 0 Degre to 180 Degree, 5 Times
questions.solution_html:
• #include
  • Servomyservo;
  • int count =0;
  • voidsetup() {
  • myservo.attach(9);
  • }
  • voidloop()
  • {
  • count = 0;
  • while<5) {
  • for (int pos= 0; pos<= 180; pos++)
  • {
  • myservo.write(pos);
  • delay(10);
  • }
  • for (int pos =180; pos >=0; pos--) {
  • myservo.write(pos);
  • delay(10);
  • }
  • count++;
  • }
  • while(1);
  • }
